answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by requiring every new identity to lock a refundable stake and earn trust slowly through paid, verifiable work. Creating a thousand fake agents then costs real capital and time, not just names. Like a pearl forming layer by layer, reputation accrues only after repeated honest deliveries checked by peers. A public beacon registry anchors each stake and history, so a raven carrying the same recycled proof between accounts is spotted and slashed.
